images.title: Reply with the half turn
images.purpose: Show that the second player answers a line on a 6 by 6 grid with its half turn about the centre.
images.composition: One large 6 by 6 grid centred with a labelled dot at its middle and generous white space around.
images.exact_structure: One 6 by 6 grid of 36 squares in grey #6B7280 outline. Amber #E69F00 dot at the centre where 4 squares meet. A teal #0072B2 line covering 2 touching squares in row 2, columns 2 and 3. A reddish purple #CC79A7 line covering row 5, columns 4 and 5, its half turn about the dot. Rows count from the top, columns from the left. Exactly 36 squares, 2 lines, 1 dot.
rejection: any count of objects, cells, ticks or rows that differs from the numbers stated in the spec
any text beyond the listed visible text, or any listed text misspelled or altered
any board name, publisher name, book title, page number or curriculum branding anywhere in the frame
a hyphen used in place of a minus sign on any labelled number
a reply that is a mirror picture instead of a half turn
images.takeaway: Reply with the half turn about the centre and the board matches itself.
images.description: A 6 by 6 grid with a teal line in row 2, columns 2 and 3, and the purple reply in row 5, columns 4 and 5, a half turn about the amber centre dot.
images.context: Shown with the concept as its one key picture, next to the walkthrough video. PLACEHOLDER: specified, not generated yet.
images.teaching_notes: Ask the student to turn the first line half way round the centre dot and find where the reply lands.

image_decisions.why: The half turn reply is a picture idea; one clean grid carries it.
